purpose: Assess the already acquired Drinkall archive before any new prediction experiment.
headline_identity: Unicode casefold plus collapsed whitespace; exact identity only, no fuzzy semantic match.
url_identity: Exact stored URL; no inferred canonicalization.
segments_scope: Unpurged article availability segments; these are not model evaluation rows.
checks: Exact headline overlap across chronological segments
Year and ticker coverage with within-year denominators
decision_rule: Any integrity failure stops reporting. Duplicate/version findings guide a separately registered cleaning experiment; do not rewrite completed pilot inputs or results.
limitations: Archive metadata cannot prove that article content is the original historical version.
Repeated headlines may be genuine recurring stories; overlap is a diagnostic, not proof of outcome leakage.
No NLP training-corpus contamination audit or semantic near-duplicate detection.
No accuracy, return or model-promotion claim from a data-quality audit.
